description:
You are a general contractor preparing a complete construction document set for the Contemporary House renovation project. A professional document set must include views from multiple angles and perspectives to fully communicate the design to subcontractors and building inspectors.

Prepare and export all four of the following views as separate JPEG image files:
1. Front elevation view (the house as seen straight-on from the front) → C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\elevation_front.jpg
2. Side elevation view (left or right side of the house) → C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\elevation_side.jpg
3. 2D floor plan of the ground floor (top-down view showing room layout) → C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\construction_floor_plan.jpg
4. 3D overview perspective (a full 3D view of the house and surroundings) → C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\construction_overview.jpg

After exporting all four views, save the working project for future revisions to:
C:\Users\Docker\Documents\construction_docs.dpn

Note: DreamPlan is already running with the Contemporary House project loaded. DreamPlan supports multiple view modes — 3D perspective, 2D floor plan, and elevation views. You will need to switch between different view modes to capture each of the four required views.
